historical_validation.design: Point-method selection: Jan 2026 only. Final coefficient fit: before Feb 1. Probability-method selection: first-half February residual fit, second-half February validation; empirical law must improve both CRPS and synthetic-threshold Brier. Residual calibration: all February. March–April labels excluded from fitting and per-market selection. This is retrospective historical validation: the initial March–April report informed addition of the generic probability gate; it is not independent proof of future performance. Current-roster sample has survivorship bias. No historical sportsbook lines or selection hit-rate claim.
historical_validation.validation_scope: retrospective player-stat forecasts, no sportsbook selection record
